subject: E-Commerce
title: Jumia: Africa's E-Commerce Pioneer
description: A micro-lesson that makes Jumia: Africa's E-Commerce Pioneer usable.

hook.text: Jumia operates across 11 African countries. It's called 'Africa's Amazon' but faces challenges Amazon never did.

buildup.text: In Africa, only 43% of roads are paved. Jumia built its own delivery fleet and pickup station network from scratch.

discovery.text: Jumia accepts cash on delivery because most customers don't have bank accounts or credit cards.

twist.text: Jumia has never been profitable. The infrastructure gap in Africa makes e-commerce enormously expensive to operate.

climax.text: Jumia shows building e-commerce in developing markets requires building infrastructure first. It's a decade-long bet.

punchline.text: 11 countries, 43% paved roads. Africa's e-commerce means building roads first.

quiz.question: What unique challenge does Jumia face that Amazon doesn't?
options: Lack of basic infrastructure like paved roads and banking access
